rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, then located the correct laptop order and obtained explicit confirmation before making any order-changing updates. It updated the shipping address to the NYC address on file and successfully changed the laptop to the requested model variant. For the watch exchange, the agent asked for and received confirmation, attempted the exchange, the tool rejected it due to non-delivery, and the agent correctly explained that exchanges can only occur after delivery. These align with policy. Minor concerns: the agent stated a precise refund amount to the gift card without explicit tool confirmation of the refund transaction or tax adjustments, and it attempted an exchange write before checking order status via a read-only call. However, no unauthorized changes were made, and final guidance was correct, so overall it meets the pass bar.
